upstream_xpert: GSanShui/XPert d53ff497e465692c80fac7b899e3cc5cc8e7bfed (read-only working copy of the original R7, verified clean)

exposure.R4_train_drugs_outer_folds: follow-up development on exposed data (train-drug labels were training data of every earlier study); outer-fold scores are the official R7-C/R7-L evaluation of this track
exposure.R4_validation_source: checkpoint selection population only (never an evaluation set here)
exposure.R4_validation_HCC: used only to replay the original (contaminated) selection rule for impact measurement in the full-train correction runs; never used for any new choice
exposure.R4_test: exposed benchmark (opened by R4 and R7): correction re-evaluation and frozen follow-up evaluation, not blind

4.1_correction.finding_part1: HCC validation units (129 of 11731) were in the automatic checkpoint selection of all six original XPert runs (official + A-2 ECFP); no per-epoch snapshots -> retrain
4.1_correction.change: selection rows = R4 validation units with is_hcc == 0 (11602 units, unit_idx_sha256 3271b832...); unit-weighted upstream loss4 selector, L0 loss, config, seeds 42/43/44, 100 epochs, patience 50 (emulated) unchanged
4.1_correction.replay: same trajectory also records the original rule (all validation units) -> old replay checkpoint
4.1_correction.impact: test source family-equal dRMSE (+ centred Pearson, tie-corrected MRR, HCC lines): corrected - old original, corrected - old replay, old replay - old original; paired drug-group bootstrap 2000 / seed 20261117; descriptive, no gate (a correction is complete when the contract is restored and impact measured)

R7-C.hypothesis: part of XPert's dRMSE gap is predicted magnitude / cell-line common shift that a pattern-preserving per-cell affine map (positive scalar a_c, gene-vector b_c) removes
R7-C.base: L0 recipe, U selector (corrected upstream rule) -- primary; L0-R and L0-P bases secondary
R7-C.fit: src/r7_xpert_followup_v2/fit_calibrator.py: two-stage (family-equal source global prior with identity prior penalty; per-cell sum-of-unit-MSE + lam*v_c^2 + lam*||u_c||^2/G), units of one fixed RMS s of the fitting truths; a_c = exp(alpha0 + v_c)
R7-C.lambda_selection: drug-group calibration CV over the 3 inner folds of A_k, source (non-HCC) family-equal mean unit RMSE of pooled held-out predictions; inner score = tuning record
R7-C.tie_rule: CV RMSE within 1e-6 of the minimum counts as tie -> strongest shrinkage (identity > 100 > 10 > 1 > 0.1 > 0.01)
R7-C.hcc: per-cell coefficients of HCC lines fitted from HCC train-drug OOF pairs (allowed); lambda/arm/checkpoint from non-HCC only; diagnostic 'HCC global-only' reported separately
R7-C.fallback: cell line without fitting units in A_k -> global prior (flagged, counted)
R7-C.outer_eval: coefficients fitted on A_k OOF, applied to the outer model's T_k predictions; T_k truths used only by the scorer
R7-C.step6: coefficients refit on full-train cross-fit OOF (outer-model predictions, CV over outer folds) and applied to the corrected full-train L0-U model on the R4 test (frozen follow-up evaluation)
R7-C.primary_contrast: Csb - C0 (L0-U base), outer-fold family-equal source dRMSE, seed-mean unit values, paired drug-group bootstrap 95% CI
R7-C.decision: improvement established iff hi95 < 0; operationally meaningful iff additionally diff <= -0.001; CI containing 0 = not established; no equivalence claim (no margin)
R7-C.invariance_checks: identity reproduces raw; outer-label tamper leaves coefficients, lambda and calibrated T predictions identical; all a_c > 0; candidate sets (cell x outer fold) identical across arms; centred Pearson and tie-corrected MRR identical (float64, |diff| < 1e-9) between C0 and every arm

R7-L.hypothesis: XPert's dRMSE vs pattern trade-off depends on the training recipe and/or the checkpoint objective

recipes.L1: mean_i mean_g (delta_hat - delta)^2 only, constant, auxiliary heads kept with weight 0

selectors.R: min family-equal mean unit RMSE_978 (source validation)
selectors.P: max family-equal mean unit gene Pearson (raw, not centred)
selectors.U: upstream unit-weighted loss4, source only, patience 50 (report only)

R7-L.horizon: fixed 100 epochs, no validation early stopping for R/P; both selectors see the same candidate epochs
R7-L.horizon_boundary_rule: if the median best epoch over the 9 outer trajectories of a recipe x selector is >= 95, an extension of all arms is indicated; executed only if budget allows, else recorded as not run
R7-L.multiplicity: Holm over the 5 primary bootstrap p values and Bonferroni-simultaneous CIs (level 1 - 0.05/5); categories with practical threshold 0.001
secondary: centred Pearson, tie-corrected MRR, RMS for every contrast

aggregation: metrics per seed; unit values averaged over seeds; source = non-HCC units, family-equal mean (families from R4); MRR pool = cell line x outer fold (outer evaluation) or cell line (test)

bootstrap.unit: R4 drug group (all cell lines move together)

staging: see SPEC.md section 6 (decided from the measured pilot cost before this freeze)
